notes.title: Major VORP Update is now live!
notes.content:
[p][img src="https://i.ibb.co/VcJdJ5Yz/VORP.jpg"][/img][/p][h1]Waddup aliens?[/h1][p]Yeah, we've been a little quiet lately - but as you might've heard, we're officially en route to Earth. No hostile takeover planned (for now) though. We just wanna zogblorp on deez nuts while beeble meeping your zinky zoogle. And of course, [b]VORP[/b].

This marks our first [i][b]MAJOR update[/b][/i] (with more on the way), so let's get into it, shall we? [/p][p][/p][h2]v1.0.7-early-access \[Build #8] [/h2][p][/p][h3]Vorp Mode Changes[/h3][p]We've made some [b]core changes[/b] to the Vorp game mode to boost fun and fairness across the table:


[b]Turn System: [/b]Players now take turns one at a time. This prevents stalling and keeps the game flowing smoothly. Additionally, after a good amount of testing we're certain that it makes it easier for the Vorp to blend in.
[b]Health Nerf:[/b] Health has been reduced from 5/5 to 3/3. This should help tighten up pacing and prevent overly long games.
[b]Damaging Changes:[/b] Previously, everyone lost 1 HP when the Vorp blended in (was not found). We've removed that mechanic to pair with the health nerf. But don't worry, we added something spicy in its place... (read below)
[b]Deadly Remote:[/b] Now, when the Vorp blends in undetected, they earn a [b]Deadly Remote[/b]; a device that lets them zap any player for 1 HP. This brings some fun chaos while balancing our new health dynamics.
Added a short cinematic intro for Vorp's 1v1 standoff that aims to quickly explain the Fusebox Roulette mechanic.
Additional UI polishes & text improvements.
Fixed a rare bug where dead players could still receive roles.
Fixed bugs that could happen when players left/disconnected mid-game during Vorp.

[/p][h3]General Notes[/h3][p]
 Heads are now 30% more jiggly!
 Fixed a Beeble Meep bug where correct cards were wrongly flagged as bluffs, causing unfair disruptions.
 Fixed a sound bug in Beeble Meep where Bluff/No Bluff sounds overlapped with the Deadeye effect.
 Fixed an issue where packet loss could break the intro cinematic and leave UI text stuck.
 Fixed network-related bugs causing raygun issues in both Beeble Meep & Zinky Zoogle.
 Fixed localization typos and mistakes across the whole game.
[/p][h3][url="https://discord.gg/6Eugbsef"]Join our Discord server to keep up with all of our updates & find players to play with![/url][/h3]

notes.title: Bogos Binted? Early Access is Now Available!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549194/8bec515a4b0dcaf6732ed4f17d110192a52d66de.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Zinky Zoogle zeekybooble beeble meep?[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Hello dear galactic travelers! 🎉
[b]Bogos Binted?[/b] is now live on Steam in Early Access![/p][p][/p][p]We’ve done our best to launch the game in its most fun and stable form. We're a small and independent team, so if you run into any bugs or missing bits, we kindly ask for your understanding. Our goal is to keep improving the game with your feedback and make each patch a little more chaotic than the last.[/p][p]We truly hope [b]Bogos Binted?[/b] brings you plenty of laughs and lots of fun.[/p][p][/p][p]New game modes, wild cosmetics, and maybe even some deckbuilding madness are already brewing in our heads. We can't wait to bring all these ideas into the game over time![/p][p][/p][p]If you're enjoying the game, dropping a review on Steam would mean the world to us - and helps a lot![/p][p][/p][p]And don’t forget to join our Discord server! Updates, patch notes, silly alien chats, and good ol' banter await you there. The link is in the game’s main menu.[/p][p][/p][p]See you around, and may your heads explode gloriously 💜👽 [/p][p]- Bad Badger Team[/p]

notes.title: Bogos Binted? Early Access
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549194/30533a0df99d5f390f18a0ba21f81bf26ed6bebc.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Well, the time has come... [b]Bogos Binted?[/b] is launching in [b]Early Access[/b] on Steam on [b]July 24, 2025[/b], featuring 4 game modes: Zogblorp, Zinky Zoogle, Beeble Meep and Vorp! Don’t forget to add it to your wishlist and get those pizzas ready. Epic nights await us... ːsteammockingː[/p]

notes.title: Important Announcement Regarding The Demo!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549194/aa7ebdcda6a3c84d1ed9afe47aabcadeb8043565.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Greetings everyone from outer space![/p][p][/p][p]First of all, a huge thank you to everyone who played our demo over the past two weeks, shared our crazy excitement, laughed, had fun, dropped amazing comments, and bullied the robot![/p][p][/p][p]Originally, we had planned to keep the demo up for just one week as part of Steam Next Fest, but due to your amazing interest, we’ve decided to extend it for another week! That means the demo will now close on [b]Monday, June 23 at 10:00 AM PT[/b]. Until then, feel free to keep playing as much as you like![/p][p][/p][p]But don’t worry! Very soon, we’ll meet again in Early Access with brand new polished game modes, shiny new content, and an awesome new level! Make sure to join our [url="https://discord.gg/nzNbWRx5Nm"]Discord server[/url] so you never miss an update![/p][p][/p][p]Also if you haven’t added the game to your wishlist yet, please don’t forget to do so! Steam will notify you when the game launches, and you’ll make us very happy ( ͡~ ͜ʖ ͡°)[/p][p][/p][p]See you again soon![/p][p]— Team Bad Badger[/p]

notes.title: Free Demo of Bogos Binted? is live for Steam Next Fest!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549194/2febb39313aba43220c7e8ed4999def791d45fb9.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hey everyone! [/p][p][/p][p]Sorry for the silence, we got too caught up playing the game and forgot to post an announcement here. As you can see, we’re live on Steam Next Fest with 3 game modes![/p][p][/p][p]From June 9–16, you can play [i]Bogos Binted?[/i] as much as you like, inflate your friends’ giant alien heads, lie through your teeth, have bizarre experiences with the greatest meme of 2025 - the Italian Brainrots - and put a hole in your best friends' face with the gun hidden under the table.[/p][p][/p][p]You might run into a few bugs or experience some wildly chaotic moments in-game, but don’t worry, all of it will be polished by the full release. For now, just have fun. We hope you enjoy the game![/p][p][/p][p]And if you could add it to your wishlist, we’d be super grateful. Our developer promised to do one push-up for every wishlist. He cries at night because of it.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you, and have fun![/p]
